exp-log-equations-intersect.alt: Graph of y = 2 to the x and the dashed line y = 10, meeting at x = log base 2 of 10, about 3.32, just right of the point (3, 8).

exp-log-equations-extraneous.alt: Graph of y = log base 3 of x plus log base 3 of (x - 8), which exists only to the right of the dashed vertical asymptote x = 8. It meets the dashed line y = 2 at the single point (9, 2). An open circle on the x-axis at x = -1 marks the extraneous root, far outside the domain.
